description: This Java class 'NotificationHelper' manages Android notifications for app updates, installations, and swaps within the F-Droid client. It handles creating, updating, and canceling notifications, including grouped and summary notifications, and loads large icons asynchronously.

classes.name: NotificationHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing Android notifications related to app updates, installations, and swaps in the F-Droid client.

methods.name: NotificationHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing notification channels, registering broadcast receiver, and setting up notification management.

methods.name: useStackedNotifications
methods.description: Determines if stacked notifications should be used based on Android SDK version.

methods.name: updateStatusLists
methods.description: Populates internal lists of updates and installed apps from the AppUpdateStatusManager.

methods.name: shouldIgnoreEntry
methods.description: Decides whether to ignore a particular app update status entry based on its state and app visibility.

methods.name: createNotification
methods.description: Creates and displays a notification for a specific app update status entry.

methods.name: createSummaryNotifications
methods.description: Creates or cancels summary notifications for updates and installed apps.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns appropriate notification action based on app update status.

methods.name: getSingleItemTitleString
methods.description: Generates notification title for a single app item based on its status.

methods.name: getSingleItemContentString
methods.description: Generates notification content text for a single app item based on its status.

methods.name: getMultiItemContentString
methods.description: Generates notification content for multiple apps based on their status.

methods.name: createUpdateNotification
methods.description: Builds a notification for an app update entry.

methods.name: createUpdateSummaryNotification
methods.description: Builds a summary notification for multiple updates.

methods.name: createInstalledNotification
methods.description: Builds a notification for an installed app.

methods.name: createInstalledSummaryNotification
methods.description: Builds a summary notification for multiple installed apps.

methods.name: getLargeIconSize
methods.description: Returns the size for large icons in notifications.

methods.name: loadLargeIconForEntry
methods.description: Loads a large icon asynchronously for a notification entry, updating the notification when ready.
